description: Run full asset build, Elixir precommit and browser suite across all configured browsers; fix failures before committing and pushing current authentication branch changes.

comments.text: Full validation underway before any commit/push. Fresh mix assets.build and mix precommit passed (179 tests, strict Credo/format/warnings checks). User stopped Firefox/WebKit. Final full-run report: 218 passed, 2 failed (same watchdog test in Chromium and Firefox), 110 WebKit tests not run. Earlier progress updates incorrectly inferred no failures from tail snippets; corrected user explicitly. Root cause: watchdog test drops widget.submit frame; Phoenix PUSH_TIMEOUT=30000 invokes reloadWithJitter and disconnects before app 300000 timeout. New connection UI correctly disables send. Test now installs clock before load and extends only its held-submit transport deadline to isolate five-minute application watchdog, preserving prior assertions plus connected-state assertion. Targeted Chromium test passed. Running full Chromium only before commit/push.

User explicitly instructed to stop all tests and commit/push, superseding full-suite completion. Stopped Chromium runner with SIGINT: 27 passed, 1 interrupted, 82 did not run; no runner remains. Earlier fresh asset build, precommit (179 tests) and distributed Mnesia checks passed. Fixed isolated watchdog test passed in Chromium. Committed all current changes as 9664c3f (feat(widget): show reconnect status and validate recovery) and pushed to origin/fix/authentication. Working tree clean.
